ops.body: ROUND-10 verdict on bacf8fbc: BLOCK on one finding, everything else in the narrow scope confirmed clean (catch-tuple coverage exact — BaseException-direct types are the only residue, MemoryError now correctly caught; all V1 tests genuine; 8 recorded-exits + shield + type-independence unchanged; 1012 passed). THE FINDING (reproduced by codex AND independently by the verifier): inside the widened except clause, reason=str(exc) is evaluated unguarded — a caught exception whose OWN __str__ raises escapes the except block, replaces the propagating exception, and suppresses the latch (repro: propagated=ValueError, is_original_cancellation=False, latch_exists=False). One-line fix, recorded as task A3.12. RECONCILIATION: while round 10 ran, the release shipped EXTERNALLY — PyPI is at 0.5.1; origin/main contains the full A1–A3.11 stack plus operator commits (docs-CI migration, prek hygiene, afb586c0 'kill the sidecar process group so a supervisor-wrapped child cannot orphan' — addresses part of the round-9 orphan finding territory; blocker 50d9590's durable-registry/startup-scan criteria remain open and should be re-evaluated against it). My lanes stop writing this tree — it is operator-active. The A3.12 fix task is queued for whoever holds the tree next; the str(exc) gap ships in 0.5.0/0.5.1 (custom-driver-only surface, built-in driver unaffected).
